main.subtitle: Calender
main.title: Calender
main.content: Manage meetings, tasks, and schedule from a centralized calendar. Plan work, organize your availability, set reminders, and manage daily commitments in a simple and clear workflow.

features.subtitle: Meetings
features.title: Schedule Meetings with Ease
content: Create and manage meetings directly from your calendar in just a few clicks. Add meeting details, participants, date, time, and duration in one place. Keep your schedule organized and get a clear view of your upcoming meetings.

features.subtitle: Tasks
features.title: Create and Track Your Tasks
content: Create tasks and organize your work directly from your calendar. Set task dates, times, and duration to plan your work more effectively. Get a clear view of upcoming and scheduled tasks alongside your meetings.

features.subtitle: Schedule
features.title: See Your Schedule at a Glance
content: View meetings and tasks together in a clear and organized calendar. Understand when each activity starts and how long it is scheduled to take. Plan your day around important meetings, tasks, and available time.
features.imageAlt: See Your Schedule at a Glance

features.subtitle: Duration
features.title: Stay on Top of Your Time
content: See the duration of every meeting and task directly on your calendar. Understand how much time is planned for each activity throughout the day. Use time information to prioritize your work and manage your schedule better. Make it easier to balance meetings, tasks, and focused work time.
features.imageAlt: Stay on Top of Your Time

features.subtitle: Tags & Filters
features.title: Find What Matters Faster
content: Organize meetings and tasks using simple tags that make your calendar easier to manage. Filter your schedule by tags to quickly find specific types of activities. Separate meetings, tasks, or other scheduled activities based on your needs.

demo.subtitle: Weblings demo
demo.title: See Weblings Workspace in Action
demo.description: Watch a quick demo showing how Weblings Workspace helps teams stay organized, collaborate effectively, and streamline daily operations.

comparison.title: How much you can save
comparison.titleDescription: Replace expensive software by replacing multiple software tools with one unified workspace. Pay only for what your team needs and scale as your business grows.
